counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event at t=143; otherwise identical. Without preemption the cycle proceeds normally with full yellow and all-red, so no violation.

explanation: Emergency preemption on W at t=143 immediately forces EW green at step 144. NS went green(142)->yellow(143)->red while EW went red->green in one second, giving NS yellow duration 1s (need 6s) and 0s all-red clearance (need 2s). The emergency handler jumps to green without enforcing yellow_duration and all_red_clearance.

violation.detail: approach 1 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 2 s)

vision_note: NS traffic shows green through step 142 then yellow at step 143 while EW traffic is held at red. At step 144 NS is red and EW is abruptly green, with no all-red clearance interval between the directions.
